question: Which customer booked the most appointments?
sql: SELECT a.customer_id, p.first_name, p.last_name, COUNT(*) AS appointment_count FROM appointments a JOIN person p ON p.id = a.customer_id GROUP BY a.customer_id, p.first_name, p.last_name ORDER BY appointment_count DESC LIMIT 1;
answer: Emma Wu (customer ID 5) booked the most appointments, with 3.
